# OptimalX product research: most-bought and most-searched nutrition and supplement products in Saudi Arabia

Status: IN PROGRESS (written incrementally). Research date: 2026-09-17. Currency: SAR. All prices are as displayed on the retailer page on the access date; Saudi retail prices include 15% VAT unless the page said otherwise.

Method: bestseller and category pages of Sporter (KSA), iHerb (SA storefront, SAR), Nahdi Online, Al-Dawaa, Noon KSA, Amazon.sa, Dr. Nutrition, GNC KSA, and Saudi Salla-based supplement stores. Every number carries the URL where it was seen and the access date.
